description: This file defines an API module for authentication-related operations, including registration, login, token refresh, and logout, with token extraction and normalization logic.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from various possible backend response shapes.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes token string by removing 'Bearer ' prefix and handling null or undefined inputs.

methods.name: safeSetTokens
methods.description: Stores tokens only if they are valid non-empty strings, preventing common header errors.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new user by sending a POST request with email and password.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login, clears old tokens, stores new tokens upon success, and returns response data.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Requests token refresh, updates stored tokens, and returns response data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the server.
